description: This PHP source file defines the 'ListCurrency' class responsible for managing currency data within a SuiteCRM module. It includes methods for currency lookup, updating, adding new currencies, generating JavaScript for currency conversion, and rendering selection options and tables related to currencies.

classes.name: ListCurrency
classes.description: A class for managing currency data, including lookup, CRUD operations, and generating currency-related UI and script elements.

methods.name: lookupCurrencies
methods.description: Fetches the list of currencies from the database and prepares it for display or processing.

methods.name: handleAdd
methods.description: Handles the addition of a new currency record, if the current user has admin privileges.

methods.name: handleUpdate
methods.description: Handles updating existing currency records based on posted form data.

methods.name: getJavascript
methods.description: Returns JavaScript code used for currency conversion and related calculations.

methods.name: getSelectOptions
methods.description: Generates HTML option tags for available currencies and initializes JavaScript variables for conversion rates and symbols.

methods.name: getTable
methods.description: Generates an HTML table for managing and displaying currency data, including add, update, and delete functionalities.

methods.name: setCurrencyFields
methods.description: Sets which form fields are associated with currency amounts for conversion purposes.
